title: Safe compact
line: See what’s using the context window before compacting.

beats.caption: You read a file in a planning session.
You ask Safe compact for its context report.
beats.label: pi-safe-compact

beats.caption: The report shows usage, thresholds, and prompt sizes.

takeaway.title: Inspect context before you compact
takeaway.line: Check what’s occupying the prompt and when compaction starts.

notes: This take uses the read-only info command and does not compact the session.

title.text: When a session grows, you can check what’s taking up space before you decide whether to compact.

scene.text: Slash safe compact info shows how much context the session is using, the thresholds for compaction, and estimates for what’s in the prompt.

takeaway.text: Use the numbers to understand the current session. The info command leaves the conversation in place.
